subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should maintainers close this protected, conflicting PR as superseded by current main's official Vertex SDK upgrade, or ask for a narrowed refresh?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot close protected maintainer/human-review items, and the remaining choice is whether any unique branch work is still wanted now that current main has the dependency-chain repair through the upstream SDK path.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Close this PR after confirming current main's provider shrinkwrap and upstream SDK path are the intended fix, then handle release and linked issue cleanup separately.

options.title: Request A Narrow Refresh
options.body: Ask for a current-main branch that preserves the official SDK path and only adds missing release, package, or proof work if any remains.

options.title: Adopt The Local Client
options.body: Keep the local BaseAnthropic/GoogleAuth client only with explicit auth-provider approval and live Vertex ADC proof.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after confirming current main's provider shrinkwrap and upstream SDK path are the intended fix, then handle release and linked issue cleanup separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc requested automerge on this protected PR and has recent release/package history on the current Anthropic Vertex provider files.
